newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat follows other markets to end up.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat follows other markets to end up.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed firm in spillover strength from other wheat markets and CBOT soybeans, traders said.
"We really just followed today. We were weak when beans were weak and rallied when beans rallied," an MGE trader said.
Spring wheat also found support in the lack of deliveries against the March contract.
MGE spring wheat settled one to 2-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with March up 2-1/4 cents at $4.08.
May gained one cent to close at $3.86-1/4, and new-crop September gained 1-1/2 cents to close at $3.72-1/2.

Traders said open interest in the March contract continued to dwindle, and the market's attention was turning to May. As of Friday, open interest in March was at eight million bushels, down 3.43 million from the previous day.
The MGE estimated Friday's spring wheat volume at 15.96 million bushels.
